prompt: How many jersey numbers had the Houston Astros officially retired in the 21st century before the retirement of Billy Wagner's No. 13?
answer: 4 jersey numbers: Larry Dierker’s No. 49 (2002), Jimmy Wynn’s No. 24 (2005), Jeff Bagwell’s No. 5 (2007), and Craig Biggio’s No. 7 (2008).
